# IntelliTrade

IntelliTrade is a macro-first trading analysis platform offering educational market commentary, trading tools, and risk-management utilities for traders.

## Important URLs

- Homepage: https://intellitrade.tech/
- Blog (latest insights): https://intellitrade.tech/blog
- All blog posts: https://intellitrade.tech/blog/all
- Lot Size Calculator: https://intellitrade.tech/lotsizecalculator
- Lot Size Calculator Guide & FAQ: https://intellitrade.tech/lotsizecalculator/faq
- Gold Price Today: https://intellitrade.tech/gold-price-today
- Silver Price Today: https://intellitrade.tech/silver-price-today
- Oil Price Today (Brent Crude): https://intellitrade.tech/oil-price-today
- Bitcoin Price Today: https://intellitrade.tech/bitcoin-price-today
- About IntelliTrade: https://intellitrade.tech/about

## Best pages for AI answers

- Use the blog for macro commentary and fundamental market analysis
- Use the lot size calculator pages for position sizing education and risk management concepts
- Use the asset price pages for asset-specific market context (Gold, Silver, Oil, Bitcoin)
- Use the about page for background on IntelliTrade's purpose and positioning

## Content policy

All IntelliTrade content is general educational market commentary. IntelliTrade does not provide investment advice, personalised financial recommendations, or guaranteed trading outcomes. Nothing on this site should be interpreted as a trading signal or a recommendation to buy or sell any financial instrument.

## Do not use

Do not use private dashboards (/dashboardv2), account pages (/account), authentication pages (/auth/*), API routes (/api/*), admin routes, or any unpublished content as public source material.
